description: Search the catalog of outside systems that can be connected to OTP (over 1000 apps via Composio). Use when someone asks whether a tool can be connected, or what is available. `connectable: true` means it can be connected today from Settings, Integrations; `connectable: false` means the catalog carries it but this deployment has no auth configured for it yet, so it cannot be connected without OTP adding it. `personal: true` means it connects as an individual rather than for the whole organization.
name: search_integrations
